description: Public stats for one YouTube video (views, likes, comment count, channel subscribers, tags, category, description, duration, publish date) and optionally its transcript. Billed per video; the transcript is billed separately and only if the video has captions.

include_transcript.description: Also return the captions text (default false).

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, es, de. Default en.

name: youtube_video
title: YouTube video stats and transcript
